description: Get the nightly price of a hotel on Google Hotels for each date in a range, by property token and guest count.

gl.description: Parameter defines the country to use for the Google Hotels search. It's a two-letter country code. (e.g., `us` for the United States, `uk` for United Kingdom, or `fr` for France) Head to the Google countries page for a full list of supported Google countries.

hl.description: Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Hotels search. It's a two-letter language code. (e.g., `en` for English, `es` for Spanish, or `fr` for French). Head to the Google languages page for a full list of supported Google languages.

adults.description: Parameter defines the number of adults. Default to `2`.

children.description: Parameter defines the number of children. Default to `0`.

currency.description: Parameter defines the currency of the returned prices. Default to `USD`. Head to the Google Travel Currencies page for a full list of supported currency codes.

end_date.description: Parameter defines the last date of the price calendar. It can't be more than 3 years from now. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**. e.g. `2027-01-11`

start_date.description: Parameter defines the first date of the price calendar. Each date has the best price of a 1-night stay starting that day. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**. e.g. `2026-11-13`

children_ages.description: Parameter defines the ages of children. The age range is from `1` to `17`, with children who haven't reached 1 year old being considered as `1`. Example for single child only: `5` Example for multiple children (separated by comma `,`): `5,8,10` The number of children's ages specified must match the `children`.

property_token.description: Parameter defines the specific property. You can find `property_token` from Google Hotels API.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

# Google Hotels Price Calendar

Get the nightly price of a hotel on Google Hotels for each date in a range, by property token and guest count.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/google-hotels/price-calendar" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"property_token": "CgsIlOPW65yHnZPwARAB", "start_date": "2026-12-10", "end_date": "2026-12-20"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

## Parameters

| `adults` | string | No | Parameter defines the number of adults. Default to `2`. |
| `children` | string | No | Parameter defines the number of children. Default to `0`. |

| `gl` | string | No | Parameter defines the country to use for the Google Hotels search. It's a two-letter country code. (e.g., `us` for the United States, `uk` for United Kingdom, or `fr` for France) Head to the Google countries page for a full list of supporte |
| `hl` | string | No | Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Hotels search. It's a two-letter language code. (e.g., `en` for English, `es` for Spanish, or `fr` for French). Head to the Google languages page for a full list of supported Google langu |
| `currency` | string | No | Parameter defines the currency of the returned prices. Default to `USD`. Head to the Google Travel Currencies page for a full list of supported currency codes. |

## Pricing
